fieldwork.subtitle: Deploying robotic systems from the Arctic to the Antarctic

entries.title: ROV Survey of Whale Bones
entries.text: ROV survey studying the ecological significance of subsistence whale remains. Imagery used to construct and label 3D models and detect changes over time.

entries.title: Sea Ice Survey from USCGC Healy
entries.text: Led ROV survey of freshly forming pancake sea ice aboard the Icebreaker Healy, collecting imagery and telemetry to analyze structural properties of Arctic sea ice.

entries.title: ROV Minerva — Shipwreck Mapping
entries.text: Integrated multi-camera rig with inertial sensing on ROV Minerva to inspect subsea infrastructure and the shipwreck Hercules in the Trondheim fjord.

entries.title: Arctic Glacier Front Mapping
entries.text: ASV field operations mapping Kongsbreen and Blomstranda glaciers to detect changes at active calving fronts.

entries.title: Antarctic Sea-Ice Study (DEFiANT)
entries.text: Designed camera units and software for the British Antarctic Survey's DEFiANT program, studying variability of Antarctic sea ice from aircraft.

entries.title: DARPA Robotics Challenge
entries.text: Sensor integration and control software for Boston Dynamics' Atlas humanoid at IHMC. Team placed 2nd in the competition.

open_source.title: MultiCamSLAM
open_source.text: A generic multi-camera SLAM system for arbitrary camera system configurations.

open_source.title: Spinnaker Camera Driver
open_source.text: ROS driver for FLIR cameras integrating Spinnaker SDK with hardware synchronization.

open_source.title: Optimal Camera Placement
open_source.text: Information-theoretic optimization for optimal camera arrangement on mobile robots.

open_source.title: Rosbag Toolkit
open_source.text: Read/write, conversion, downsampling, filtering, and visualization of rosbags.

open_source.title: NUFR-M3F Dataset
open_source.text: Multi-modal multi-floor SLAM dataset with cameras, IMU, and LiDAR sensors.

teaching.title: EECE 7150: Autonomous Field Robots
teaching.text: Northeastern University. Complete teaching responsibility for this graduate-level course — designing syllabus, lectures, projects, and assignments.

teaching.title: EECE 5554: Robot Sensing & Navigation
teaching.text: Developed materials for the graduate-level course, mentored students on projects, and shared teaching and grading responsibilities.

teaching.title: Graduate Student Mentoring
teaching.text: Mentored multiple master's students on theses and projects in robotics and engineering, including students advised by Dr. Singh and Dr. Rosen.
